The ionic equation for the reaction of aqueous iron(II) sulfate with acidified aqueous
potassium manganate(VII) is shown.
5Fe2++MnO4
–+8H+→5Fe3++Mn2++4H2O
Which statement about the reaction is correct?
A
The iron(II) ions gain electrons.
B
The iron(II) ions act as an oxidising agent.
C
The manganate(VII) ions are reduced.
D
The oxidation state of the iron(II) ions decreases.

options.label: B
options.text: The iron(II) ions act as an oxidising agent.

options.label: D
options.text: The oxidation state of the iron(II) ions decreases.
